_doc: The player models the Roblox port ships (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, Player roster). Read by oaconv convert, tools/roster.py (client/server file packs, botfiles, place/assemble.py) and the lune test hosts. An excluded name drops models/players/<name>/, models/players/heads/<name>/, sound/player/<name>/, scripts/<name>.vc and scripts/player_<name>.shader; an excluded <model>/<skin> drops that skin's .skin files and icons plus the paths (and shader names) starting with a prefix listed for it in files. Bots whose model is excluded leave scripts/bots.txt, and arenas name the substitute in arena_bots instead.

kept.sarge: armoured soldier; arms bare, torso plated. The classic skins (Grism bot) paint a cartoon bare abdomen strip under an open vest: kept, flagged for Chee
kept.grism: not a model: the texture folder sarge's skins use
kept.assassin: hooded robe and mask, fully covered
kept.beret: soldier in a vest or tank top (default, macho/Morgan, cooldude); the Headcrash skin is dropped below
kept.gargoyle: green/stone/tech creature skins, no human-like torso; the l_gen surface named in its .skin does not exist in lower.md3
kept.liz: scaled lizard creature with belly plates
kept.sergei: armoured, clothed; the 0.8.8 team default model

excluded.hnt: Angelyss's red, blue and dark skin textures (pak6-patch085)
excluded.kyonshi: female model (also the missionpack team head models/players/heads/kyonshi)
excluded.arachna: female model (mature pk3 only; its bot, voice, shader and sounds are in the other pk3s)
excluded.ayumi: female model (mature pk3 only; bots Ayumi and Jenna)
excluded.merman: the body texture is a realistic bare human torso (pecs, abs, flesh tone) that a nudity classifier can read as a nude torso
excluded.beret/headcrash: headcrash1.jpg paints a bare hairy chest with a nipple and no vest over it
